name: Treasury Flight-to-Quality Hedge Overlay
description: Regime-dependent overlay that tilts duration (VUTY) when flight-to-quality conditions are detected. Classifies regime from joint behavior of equity sleeve and Treasury prices over 20-day trailing window: flight-to-quality regime = negative stock-bond correlation + equities in drawdown signals growth/demand shock and triggers 15pp tilt to VUTY funded from equity sleeve. Inflation/rate-shock regime (positive correlation or no stress) leaves base weights unchanged — critically does NOT fire on positive-correlation sell-offs. Expected benefit: 0.1-0.2 Sharpe uplift and drawdown reduction in growth-shock episodes, offset by neutral-to-mildly-negative effect in inflation shocks.
